how_to_send.to_a_group: Composio tool TIMELINESAI_SEND_MESSAGE. The two fields are chat_id and message — chat_id must be a STRING ("59734285", not 59734285) and the body goes under `message`, not `text`. Get either wrong and the call is rejected 400 before it reaches WhatsApp, so nothing is sent and it is safe to correct and retry.
how_to_send.to_a_person: Composio tool TIMELINESAI_POST_MESSAGE with phone, whatsapp_account_phone '+50769027049' and text. Works for any number, no chat needed first.
how_to_send._why_not_direct: app.timelines.ai is not reachable from this container (the egress proxy refuses it). The Composio tools run on Composio's own infrastructure, so they get through. Direct API calls only work from a Composio sandbox.
how_to_send._composio_bug: TIMELINESAI_GET_CHATS drops every parameter it accepts — types, search, limit, offset and sort are all ignored and it always returns the same first 50 chats alphabetically. That is why the group ids are written down here instead of being looked up. The real REST API honours group=true, name= and page=.

a_picture._why: Composio's TimelinesAI tools send text only. The real API takes a file, and it is reachable from Composio's own sandbox (COMPOSIO_REMOTE_BASH_TOOL) even though it is not reachable from this container.
recipe: In the sandbox: curl the renderer from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moshiko3-lab/-/main/bloowatch/draw_board.py (the repo is public, so it always pulls the version that is checked in).

Write the output of `python3 board.py --spec` to spec.json there — about two kilobytes, which fits in one command. A rendered PNG does not: a single sandbox command tops out around 6 KB and the picture is 30.
a_picture._note: `text` is the image's caption, so the rota and the picture arrive as ONE message. No trailing slash on the URL — with one it 404s. The sandbox needs Pillow built with raqm or the Hebrew comes out backwards; it has it.
a_picture._caption_limit: WhatsApp cuts a caption around 1024 characters. On a big day send the picture with a short caption and the full rota as a second message.
a_picture._two_kinds: There are two boards. shot.py photographs the real Bloowatch planner (what the owner asked for on 2026-09-02) and board.py draws our own. Send the photograph; fall back to the drawing only if the browser route fails, because a rota with a drawn board beats a rota with none.

the_screenshot.make_it: BLOOWATCH_EMAIL/PASSWORD set, then `python3 shot.py --out board.png`. Squeeze it before sending: resize to 2143 wide and quantize to 16 colours (about 33 KB). Below 16 colours the pink blocks lose their text and the picture is worthless.
the_screenshot.carry_it: base64 it and paste it into the sandbox in pieces of about 6000 characters, appending each to the same file — a single message cannot carry more than roughly 6.9 KB, and a longer paste is silently cut. About seven pieces. After the last one, `base64 -d` it and check the byte count matches before sending.
the_screenshot._why_not_smaller: app.timelines.ai is unreachable from this container, so the file has to travel to the sandbox, and the sandbox has no browser to take the shot itself.

rules: Nothing goes to a group without the owner having approved that exact message going to that exact group.
A group only appears in TimelinesAI once a message arrives in it; it does not backfill history.
